# CityWorld Neo intercity bridge drive runtime fixture

The AngelScript diagnostic in this directory is original project work and is
licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.

The fixture contains no CityWorld geometry, textures, placements, or archive
payloads. At runtime it drives the packaged DAF over the caller-supplied,
authenticated `CityWorld.zip` and the locally generated
`CityWorldNextLocalOverlay.zip`. Those private packages remain separate and
are not redistributable through this repository or the diagnostic artifacts.
